title: RootQuantV2: Adapting a Vision Foundation Model for Root-Trait Regression from Minirhizotron Imagery
abstract: arXiv:2609.25567v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A lack of high-throughput phenotyping solutions for root traits in field-grown crops has severely constrained understanding and improvement of below-ground traits and processes. Minirhizotrons are the standard non-destructive root-phenotyping method in field environments. Computer vision solutions are needed to allow automated trait estimation at scale, but training data is scarce and human annotations are often inaccessible because they reside in proprietary software that only exports per-image scalar totals of root length and surface area. Nevertheless, large numeric archives of these root traits already exist. RootQuant showed that the traits can be predicted directly from the whole image by regression, thus removing manually traced masks from the pipeline; RootQuantV2 takes that idea further by replacing RootQuant's CNN backbone with a self-supervised ViT. We adapt a frozen DINOv3 ViT-L/16 with a hybrid parameter-efficient scheme.

translated_title: RootQuantV2：将视觉基础模型适配于微根管图像的根系性状回归
translated_abstract: 田间作物根系性状缺乏高通量表型分析解决方案，严重制约了对地下性状和过程的理解与改良。微根管是田间环境中标准的无损根系表型分析方法。为实现大规模自动化性状估计，需要计算机视觉解决方案，但训练数据稀缺，且人工标注往往难以获取，因为它们存储在专有软件中，只能导出每张图像的根长和表面积的标量总和。尽管如此，这些根系性状的大量数值档案已经存在。RootQuant 表明这些性状可以通过回归直接从整张图像中预测，从而在流程中省去了人工描绘的掩膜；RootQuantV2 进一步发展了这一思想，用自监督 ViT 替换了 RootQuant 的 CNN 骨干网络。我们采用混合参数高效方案对冻结的 DINOv3 ViT-L/16 进行适配。
tldr: RootQuantV2 用自监督视觉 Transformer（DINOv3 ViT）替换 CNN 骨干，通过混合参数高效微调，直接从微根管图像回归预测根系性状，摆脱了对人工标注掩膜的依赖。
en_tdlr: RootQuantV2 replaces RootQuant's CNN backbone with a self-supervised DINOv3 ViT adapted via a hybrid parameter-efficient scheme, enabling direct regression of root traits from minirhizotron images without manually traced masks.
